content_sections.heading: Birbhum AYUSH Recruitment 2026 Overview
content_sections.text: The notification (Memo No: DMO/AYUSH/ Birbhum/461) is a contractual recruitment under the National AYUSH Mission for Yoga Instructors in AYUSH clinics of Birbhum district and for support staff at the AYUSH District Programme Management Unit (DPMU), Birbhum. The notice does not print a combined total; the figure of 52 is the sum of the post-wise numbers it prints.

content_sections.heading: About Birbhum AYUSH
content_sections.text: The recruitment is run by the AYUSH Branch of the Office of the Chief Medical Officer of Health & Secretary, District Health and Family Welfare Samity, Birbhum, located at Old Outdoor Campus, Suri, Birbhum. The notice is signed by the District Medical Officer (AYUSH), Birbhum, and the Chief Medical Officer of Health, Birbhum. The posts are funded under the National AYUSH Mission, and the DPMU Section manages the recruitment process.

content_sections.heading: Birbhum AYUSH Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: Registration and fee payment close two days before the final form submission. A candidate who has not registered and paid by midnight of 3 December 2026 cannot complete the application by 5 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: Birbhum AYUSH Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The notice offers 52 posts in all (21 + 27 + 1 + 1 + 2).

content_sections.heading: Birbhum AYUSH Category-wise Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The category break-up is printed for the two Yoga Instructor posts only. The Accountant, LDC and Group - D posts are marked "Retired Person" with no category split.

content_sections.heading: Birbhum AYUSH Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: The applicant must be a permanent resident of West Bengal. This applies to applicants of all categories. The applicant must have knowledge of local languages. All essential criteria and the essential qualification must be completed on or before the first date of online application. Experience will be calculated after obtaining the required essential academic qualification for the post, till the first date of online application. Caste/EWS certificates are accepted only when issued on or before the first date of online application by the competent authorities of West Bengal. The essential criteria are the minimum; merely meeting them does not entitle a candidate to claim selection. Candidates should check the official notification for the exact eligibility of each post.

rows.qualification_required: Secondary/Madhyamik passed with Certificate/Diploma/Degree in Yoga affiliated by the West Bengal Council of Yoga Naturopathy (WBCYN).
Retired State Government Employee (Accountant); Computer Knowledge.

content_sections.heading: Birbhum AYUSH Salary 2026
content_sections.text: Yoga Instructor pay is worked out per session at Rs. 250/- per session: 32 sessions for the male post and 20 sessions for the female post. The Accountant, LDC and Group - D posts carry a fixed amount per month. The notice does not mention any allowance on top of these amounts.

content_sections.heading: Birbhum AYUSH Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: The fee is paid through online mode only, by net banking or credit/debit card, up to midnight of 3 December 2026. The amount paid is non-refundable. Candidates must not deposit the fee more than one time.

content_sections.heading: Birbhum AYUSH Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Yoga Instructor (Male and Female): shortlisting on marks obtained in educational qualifications, a merit list, then demonstration and interview. Accountant, LDC and Group - D: selection procedure will be as per the decision of the DLSC Committee and will be notified later. Candidates will be selected from the merit list according to vacancy. Final selection will be done based on marks obtained on merit, interview and experience, if any. For both Yoga Instructor posts, 1:5 candidates will be shortlisted as per Academic Merit, that is, the marks out of 30 for Secondary/Madhyamik and the yoga qualification. Marks are rounded off up to 2 decimal points.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for Birbhum AYUSH Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Go to www.wbhealth.gov.in and open the "On-line Recruitment" link (the notice gives the address as www.wbhealth.gov.in/online recruitment). Register online in the prescribed format between 11 am of 20.11.2026 and midnight of 03.12.2026, and note the application id and online registration number. Upload a proper signature and photograph; an application without them is liable to be cancelled. Pay the fee online through net banking or credit/debit card by midnight of 03.12.2026, only once. After a successful payment you return to the link for final submission; complete it using the application id received at registration, by midnight of 05.12.2026. Download the registration form from http://hr.wbhealth.gov.in under "Application Print" and keep it for document verification. Do not send a hard copy by post.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Signature and photograph, uploaded with the online application. Caste/EWS certificate issued on or before the first date of online application by the competent authorities of West Bengal. Print copy of the online registration form; without it, candidates will not be entertained for original testimonials verification. Original testimonials for verification; online details that differ from them make the application liable to be cancelled.

content_sections.text: The engagement is on a contractual basis under the National AYUSH Mission. Only online applications will be accepted. Candidates found ineligible at any stage will not be called for the subsequent stages of selection. The decision of the competent authorities regarding the recruitment is final, and they may cancel the recruitment process at any stage without showing any explanation. Information and instructions issued from time to time will appear at www.wbhealth.gov.in (link "Recruitment") and on the Birbhum district website, www.birbhum.nic.in . faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Birbhum AYUSH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 52 posts: 21 Yoga Instructor (Male), 27 Yoga Instructor (Female), 1 Accountant, 1 Lower Division Clerk (LDC) and 2 Group - D.

faq.question: Q2. When does the Birbhum AYUSH online application start?
faq.answer: Online registration, fee payment and form submission open from 11 am of 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for Birbhum AYUSH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Online registration and fee payment close at midnight of 3 December 2026, and the final submission of applications closes at midnight of 5 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 100/- for general candidates and Rs. 50/- for reserved category candidates, paid online only by net banking or credit/debit card; it is non-refundable.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Birbhum AYUSH Yoga Instructor?
faq.answer: Yoga Instructor candidates must be a minimum of 21 years and a maximum of 40 years as on 1st January 2026 (DOB within 01/01/1976 to 01/01/2006). For the Accountant, LDC and Group - D posts the range is 60 to 62 years.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for the Yoga Instructor post?
faq.answer: Secondary/Madhyamik passed with a Certificate/Diploma/Degree in Yoga affiliated by the West Bengal Council of Yoga Naturopathy (WBCYN).

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary of a Birbhum AYUSH Yoga Instructor?
faq.answer: Yoga Instructor (Male) gets Rs. 8000/- (32 sessions x Rs. 250/- per session) and Yoga Instructor (Female) gets Rs. 5000/- (20 sessions x Rs. 250/- per session).

faq.question: Q8. How are Yoga Instructors selected?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted 1:5 on academic merit out of 30 and then scored on demonstration (10 marks) and interview (10 marks), for full marks of 50.

faq.question: Q9. Can retired employees apply, and how is their pay fixed?
faq.answer: Yes. The Accountant, LDC and Group - D posts are only for retired State Government employees aged 60 to 62, at a fixed Rs. 12000/-, Rs. 10000/- and Rs. 8000/- per month respectively.

faq.question: Q10. Is the Birbhum AYUSH job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The posts are filled on a contractual basis under the National AYUSH Mission.
